Native speech runtime bundled with the Windows desktop application:

sherpa-onnx 1.13.8
https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/releases/tag/v1.13.8
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/v1.13.8/LICENSE

ONNX Runtime 1.28.2 (version reported by the DLL bundled in the sherpa-onnx
1.13.8 Windows x64 shared MT release archive)
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.28.2/LICENSE
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime/v1.28.2/ThirdPartyNotices.txt

The package script includes all DLL files from the Cargo release directory.
llama.cpp and model weights are installed separately by checksum-verified
preparation scripts; they are not part of the desktop ZIP.
